assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 绿地蓝线、文物与建设控制等法定控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何容积率、高度、红线等具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径示意与校核建议。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory control conditions (green/blue lines, heritage, construction controls) are unknown; no FAR, height or redline conclusions are given.

assumptions.statement_zh: 五类治理指标与三项formal核心指标均为概念口径：前者不作为现状监测结果，后者以本包几何复算为准；官方统计口径确认前不替代官方统计。
assumptions.statement_en: The five governance indicators are concept calibers, not current monitoring results; the three formal core metrics are recomputed from this package's geometry only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 指标枢、监测驿与公示亭三节点均为原创概念建议，模块化可逆，不构成建设承诺；品牌名称与标识在在先权利检索完成前按内部工作代号处理。
assumptions.statement_en: All three nodes are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments; brand names are internal working codenames until prior-rights clearance.

assumptions.statement_zh: 公众反馈AI仅处理匿名聚合数据并设最低聚合阈值：自由文本先脱敏、最小收集、日志与权限分级、保存删除流程、错误更正与申诉通道、事件响应与公开反馈闭环；关键决策人工复核，禁止过度监控。
assumptions.statement_en: Public-feedback AI processes anonymized aggregates only, with a minimum aggregation threshold, desensitization, minimal collection, access logging, retention/deletion flows, correction/appeal channels and human review of key decisions.

assumptions.statement_zh: 年度指标开放日、年度实施进度通报会与监测驿体验周等均为建议性活动设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: Annual programs (Indicator Open Day, progress briefing, Monitoring Post Experience Week) are design suggestions, not confirmed government or investment commitments.
